title: Before You Build a Smart List
learningGoal: Plan the Smart List before creating it to ensure it stays useful.

items.title: Know your group
items.description: What group of contacts do you want to find?

items.title: Know your why
items.description: Why does this list matter? What will you do with it?

items.title: Plan your filters
items.description: What filters will help you find them?

items.title: Choose a clear name
items.description: Use a name that explains exactly what the list shows

items.title: Who do I want to find?
Why do I need this list?
What action follows?
items.description: What will you do after finding them?

items.title: Will I use this again?
items.description: Is this a one-time need or ongoing?

keyPoint: If you do not know why you need the Smart List, do not create it yet.

actionSteps.title: Choose a group to find
actionSteps.description: Example: New leads from the last 30 days

actionSteps.title: Define your reason
actionSteps.description: Example: I want to follow up with recent leads

actionSteps.title: Plan your filters
actionSteps.description: Example: Date added, lead status, contact type

quizzes.question: What should you do before creating a Smart List?

options.option_text: Plan who you want to find, why you need it, what filters to use, and choose a clear name
Ask someone else to create it

quizzes.explanation: Planning before creating prevents building lists that are unclear or unused. Know your group, your why, your filters, and your name before starting.
